scope: Unify explicit XML/cache/local HTTP initialization with real original-only browser launcher I/O; no original executable/VM/account/official game action.

target_binding.validation: Re-validate owned raw pair, digests and parsed model; select only referenced available non-Galaxy region;0..14 numeric message code; reject no BIP and any unapproved tuple; no pruning or URL grants.
target_binding.identity: Request gameCode is numeric original Game.Code; license gameCodeText preserves exact parsed digit text, including leading zeros. Duplicate Code entries keep game ordinal. No UI-index/+1 conversion.
target_binding.output: Frozen game/region ordinals/names, exact Code text, numeric Code, ordered owned address/port endpoints and catalog digest identity; trust/authentication unverified.

bootstrap_source.purpose: Serve only explicitly injected owned original source bytes at fixed local routes; no filesystem input, upstream proxy, arbitrary routes or official defaults.
bootstrap_source.options: Explicit utf-8/gb18030 and boolean allowBareAmpersands. Own data properties; copy inputs, fixed responses return copies, dispose clears owned buffers.
bootstrap_source.empty_policy: Local reference bodies may be empty; remote XML and metadata must be nonempty.
bootstrap_source.runtime_descriptor: moli.local-bootstrap.v1, same-origin fixed localInputs and5 existing bootstrap endpoints; optional package locator is same-origin /bootstrap/package plus original positive progress100. This is original fixture service data, not a new native field.
bootstrap_source.server_schema: moli.loopback.v2 adds optional bootstrap descriptor. Legacy optional gameCode metadata remains validated but session UI no longer uses it; selected XML Code is authoritative.
bootstrap_source.transport_guards: Existing loopback bind/Host/Sec-Fetch-Site/source paths/CSP/Origin/capability/endpoint and byte/time limits preserved.

inputs: explicit local HTTP prepare button if source configured
configuration_UI.initial_state: No candidate, account/review/start disabled. No cache open/restore or protocol socket at page load.
configuration_UI.local_files: Existing1MiB owned file adapter, explicit encoding and bare-ampersand switch, whole-pair digest/structure validation before target.
configuration_UI.bootstrap: Local launcher/XML references load via existing explicit-origin GET client; existing prepare self-update-first branch runs; whole candidate pair applies only when catalogs-prepared. Self-update branch displays validated candidate only, with no catalog/session target or execution.
configuration_UI.deadline: One10,000ms monotonic deadline covers local-reference loading plus prepare; remaining time passed to every client call and prepare; absolute time checked before apply.
configuration_UI.cache: Existing launcher-local profile, source pair/MD5/encoding/compatibility only. Explicit check then CAS save/restore; info check never applies; reload does not auto-restore. Unknown/corrupt/conflict state never auto-overwrites or deletes; current validated model survives failed info/save. Late successful commit reports saved, not rolled back.
configuration_UI.invalidation: Configuration/file/options/game/region changes clear old selected target, user/password DOM values, text pages/consent and candidate session. Busy/review locks configuration controls; separate cancel aborts own operation and generation/signal guards reject late results.
configuration_UI.manual_scope: Manual file/cache paths are explicit development paths; they do not prove native self-update completion, official source trust or current server compatibility.
configuration_UI.error_handling: Controlled visible status, no source payload/provider exception/account values in messages.

session_UI.change: Uses bound target endpoints and numeric configured Code; license review receives preserved Code text. No runtime-code +1 policy remains in UI.
session_UI.counter: Independent current-page0..UInt32 counter increments per constructed attempt; two same-page attempts verified with0 then1, not a complete native counter lifecycle proof.
session_UI.unsupported: Actual ACP/non-ASCII and unconfigured license slots remain unsupported/unverified. No real account store or game handoff.

testing.browser_negative_fixture: Only cancellation/timeout cases hold original local responses with Playwright routes; successful end-to-end protocol cases use actual HTTP/IndexedDB/native WebSocket/TCP.

not_verified: real applicable terms/account persistence, service identity/authentication/opaque lifecycle
trusted official update/native replacement/rollback or remote/mobile transport
